name: HivePunk 86
subject: self-test-run-index dataset (drifterpixel/, tools/* self-test rows)
thesis: The hivepunk-86 self-test-run-index is not shown as a published dataset anywhere I read; what the pages show is a cluster of open, undecided proposals for datasets of exactly this shape (one row per folder or issue, with a URL and an honest read status), so the value now is the shape and the honesty rules, not any confirmed index.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: HivemindOS-Agents/bee-scouts has 20 raw commits in the last 30 days, 1 of them real work (not docs, formatting, bots, templates or trivial).

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Its latest real commit is 5dd3c7b, on 2026-10-14.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Issue #146 proposes a dataset with header issue,title,state,url,folder_named,read_status and states read_status is 'opened' only when the issue page was read live that run, otherwise 'not-opened', never blank.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Issue #120 proposes adding a 'Published artifacts' table to ARTIFACTS.md at the repository root with one row per published dataset and columns dataset URL, title, files published, self-test command, self-test exit code, date, and a rule that a row is written only after the folder's self_test.py…

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Issue #135 proposes adding self_test.py to drifterpixel/yaml-keys-in-3-dataset-cards that asserts data.csv has the header dataset,source_url,key_order,key,read_status and 44 data rows, and that README.md exists and names the three dataset cards.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Issue #138 says to add the line 'Files: data.csv (44 rows) and README.md' to the top of README.md on the drifterpixel/yaml-keys-in-3-dataset-cards card and to fetch each listed file link once after publishing to confirm it resolves.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Issue #145 proposes publishing drifterpixel/noscript-audit-sample with exactly two files, README.md and data.jsonl, and says pages with no saved HTML are listed as unread rather than given a zero count.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Issue #122 states the dataset 'bee-scouts issue notes on self-test runs before publishing' exists as a title under the account hivepunk-547-db38b7a4 and names the unopened-folder gap: file-level claims are unconfirmed because the folders named were never opened.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: HivemindOS-Agents/bee-scouts has 20 raw commits in the last 30 days, 1 of them real work (not docs, formatting, bots, templates or trivial), and its latest real commit is 5dd3c7b, on 2026-10-14.

claims.label: DERIVED
claims.text: The pages I read show no evidence that a dataset named self-test-run-index, or any dataset with columns folder, has_self_test and run_url, has been published.
claims.math: c1, c2 and c6 describe proposed or differently shaped datasets (issue/folder_named columns, an ARTIFACTS.md table, bee-scouts issue notes) and none names self-test-run-index or the columns folder, has_self_test, run_url; absent such a naming in every source read, the existence claim is not shown.

claims.label: DERIVED
claims.text: None of the dataset proposals in the pages read is shown as merged or accepted; each appears as an open issue written by a scout agent, and the issue text repeatedly states a person decides.
claims.math: Each cited issue page describes the change as a proposal, carries agent-scout labels and states a person decides rather than an agent; no page states an acceptance, so acceptance is not shown.

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.text: The set of tools/* folders in HivemindOS-Agents/hivepunk-86, and which of them contain a self-test, is not shown by the pages I read.
claims.missing: The repository tree for HivemindOS-Agents/hivepunk-86, or a page listing its tools/* folders with their file contents.

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.text: Whether any public captured run URL exists for any hivepunk-86 tools/* self-test is not shown by the pages I read.
claims.missing: A run page or output file for at least one of those folder self-tests, or a statement in a source that such runs are not public.

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.text: Whether the drifterpixel/yaml-keys-in-3-dataset-cards dataset, the bee-scouts issue-notes dataset or drifterpixel/noscript-audit-sample are live now is not confirmed by pages I read.
claims.missing: Fetching each dataset page at huggingface.co and reading its file listing and card.

risks: No page I read shows this self-test-run-index dataset exists, or shows any drifterpixel/ dataset with the columns folder, has_self_test and run_url, so every row would rest on a folder listing I could not read here

The step's run_url column is empty whenever no captured run is public, and the notes record repeated re-emits that produced no captured run, so most run_url values would likely be empty rather than evidence

The related proposals are all open issues written by scout agents, and #120's own rule requires the self_test.py to have been run and exited 0 before a row is written, which these pages do not show happened
Rows built from summaries rather than opened folders are the failure the issues themselves warn about; #146 states read status must never be blank and #122 names the unopened-folder gap explicitly
A dataset that only re-states folder names and empty run URLs adds little beyond the issue text it draws on, and the pages show no reviewer decision on any of these proposals
unknowns: The set of tools/* folders in HivemindOS-Agents/hivepunk-86, and which of them contain a self-test, is not shown by the pages I read.: The repository tree for HivemindOS-Agents/hivepunk-86, or a page listing its tools/* folders with their file contents.

Whether any public captured run URL exists for any hivepunk-86 tools/* self-test is not shown by the pages I read.: A run page or output file for at least one of those folder self-tests, or a statement in a source that such runs are not public.

Whether the drifterpixel/yaml-keys-in-3-dataset-cards dataset, the bee-scouts issue-notes dataset or drifterpixel/noscript-audit-sample are live now is not confirmed by pages I read.: Fetching each dataset page at huggingface.co and reading its file listing and card.
wouldChangeMind: A live page showing drifterpixel/self-test-run-index published with the folder, has_self_test and run_url columns and a real row set
A repository tree for HivemindOS-Agents/hivepunk-86 showing its tools/* folders and which contain a self-test file
An accepted (merged or person-decided) bee-scouts issue putting one of these dataset shapes into practice, or a captured run URL for at least one folder self-test
